# First-party API — owner handoff template

- Task/repository, clean branch and exact upstream source SHA:
- Runtime owner: Windows/Docker, owner-proven healthy API evidence:
- Gateway provider package, fixed operation names, params/result schema:
- Transport profile: WIN-HTTPS / DOCKER-HTTPS, HTTPS origin and DNS name:
- Public pinned CA path/digest and owner of CA key rotation (never key):
- Network from actual Gateway to upstream; tested DNS and port/bind:
- Upstream minimum privilege, exact GET routes and resource targets:
- Vault alias and credential-generation/readiness status (no secret):
- Public manifest path/hash and source/negative test commands:
- GitHub PR, exact SHA/merge, Source CI + Release Impact proof:
- Protected Gateway current/source/backup record identity (no payload):
- Current UNCERTAIN/CLAIMED/APPROVED UUIDs and owner worker quiescence:
- Old runtime image/isolated restore proof; STOP if missing:
- Owner-managed single release window; Check/Apply/Backup/Promote evidence:
- Fresh host and typed Gateway catalog/call + wrong-scope denial:
- Remaining blockers, ownership and one next safe operation:

Never classify a hypothetical fixture or SOURCE_READY as live activation.
No credential values, private CA, owner shell command or protected record contents.
